comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
**Fixed** on `main` in commit `5eb63ca90` (`fix(#102): race between sync watcher and tree mutation`).

The crash was a classic foreach-over-shared-collection race: the file-watcher reload path started enumerating the tree while the UI thread was adding/removing nodes. The fix is a snapshot-then-enumerate pattern and a lock on the mutation boundaries.

Please grab the next nightly (build ≥ 3455) and confirm you no longer see `Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute.` during...
